evidence: Substantively changes transaction witness representation in src/script/script.h and script interpreter execution in src/script/interpreter.cpp.
rationale: Mitigates a potential memory-amplification denial-of-service vector where adversarial transactions consumed excessive memory. According to the PR description, the "worst-case allocated size for transactions kept in memory drops from roughly 28 bytes/WU to 1.6 bytes/WU", substantially reducing adversarial memory exhaustion risk at a minor validation CPU trade-off.
